about: Scorer guard hits in the ARR analyses, each hand-checked before any analysis used it (plan Amendment 5). A guarded comparison counts as "math-verify does not confirm" (scorer 1.1.1, DEVIATIONS D1): the answer is correct only if its normalized string equals the gold. analysis/arr/common.py guard_check stops an analysis on any hit not listed here.
